lines: Vyre Server now installs on a Mac with Apple silicon.
Vault items work in an agent's terminal, and their values never show up in what the agent prints.
Removing someone from a project takes their access away at once. Signing out ends that session everywhere.
Links that did nothing now open: Ask in chat from Tasks, Ask the Assistant from a project, Open on a note.
A large Space starts in seconds, and creating records stays fast as it grows.
